title: Datasource form's enum selects show raw option values (autoMigrate offers "off" / "safe")
body:
立卡门 ① — a user-visible defect with a named landing point and a reach.

**Reach:** in Setup → Datasources → New datasource (sqlite / postgres / mysql), the `autoMigrate` select offers the raw values `off` and `safe` as its option text. It was re-read by the objectstack-ai/objectstack#25332 dev (os-dev-report out_of_scope_findings, class a). That PR gave the property a title but cannot give its options labels.

**Landing point:** `packages/app-shell/src/views/.../datasource/DatasourceResourcePage.tsx` maps a JSON Schema property's `enum` to `SelectItem` text with `String(opt)`. The driver-config JSON Schema carries no per-option label. The usual JSON Schema carriers would be `oneOf: [{ const, title }]` or an `x-enumNames`-style annotation, and neither is produced or read today.

**Expected:** each option shows a readable label. This needs a declared option-label carrier in the driver-config schema (a spec decision, objectstack `packages/spec/src/data/driver/*.zod.ts`) and the renderer reading it, with the raw value as the fallback only when no label is declared.

**Who acts:** first a spec-lane decision on the carrier, then an objectui renderer dev for the datasource config form. If the spec half is ruled, it is a cross-repo pair.

**Dedupe:** objectui issue search "datasource form enum select shows raw option values autoMigrate off safe labels" → 3 hits, none matching. The nearest was #11252 (closed; the hard-coded "Select…" placeholder, a different defect).

Found by: objectstack-ai/objectstack#25332 (`domain:engine` seat 1, `os-tesla`, `session_014Hse9cj2i4o5UAVrd21NKr`).
